moods.mood_description: The prince seeks the truth beyond the palace walls
Whether the prince will choose the throne or the path of the sage
The restlessness beneath the prince's luxury, the question the palace cannot answer
The sheltered life of pleasure versus the reality of suffering
The four sights shatter the prince's world
The king believes pleasure can shield his son; the prince senses a deeper truth
The prince is not content with the palace's answers
The question takes hold: why do we suffer, and can suffering be ended?
A glimpse of the great renunciation to come
The palace built to keep the prince from suffering becomes the very thing he must leave
